name: Partner Plan of Action (POA) Lifecycle Management

nodes.name: IF - Review or Score or Overdue

parameters.subject: =POA Requires Review — {{ $json.partnerName }} ({{ $json.quarter }})
=✅ POA Approved — {{ $json.partnerName }} ({{ $json.quarter }})
parameters.text:
=Dear {{ $json.partnerName }} team,

Great news! Your Plan of Action for {{ $json.quarter }} has been **approved**.

---
POA ID: {{ $json.poaId }}
Quarter: {{ $json.quarter }}
Revenue Target: ${{ Number($json.revenueTarget).toLocaleString() }}
Deals Target: {{ $json.dealsTarget }}
MDF Requested: ${{ Number($json.mdfRequested).toLocaleString() }}

{{ $json.reviewComments ? 'Reviewer Comments:
' + $json.reviewComments + '
' : '' }}
---

**Next Steps:**
1. Execute your plan for the quarter
2. Track progress against targets
3. MDF claims can be submitted for approved activities
4. End-of-quarter scoring will evaluate attainment

If you have questions, contact your channel manager.

Best,
Channel Operations Team
channel@example-channel.com

parameters.subject: =🔄 POA Needs Revision — {{ $json.partnerName }} ({{ $json.quarter }})
parameters.text:
=Dear {{ $json.partnerName }} team,

Your Plan of Action for {{ $json.quarter }} has been reviewed and **needs revision** before it can be approved.

---
POA ID: {{ $json.poaId }}
Quarter: {{ $json.quarter }}

**Feedback from Channel Manager:**
{{ $json.reviewComments || 'Please revise your plan and resubmit.' }}
---

**How to Resubmit:**
Revise your POA and POST to the webhook with:
- action: "submit"
- poaId: "{{ $json.poaId }}"
- Updated goals, targets, and initiatives

Please resubmit within 10 business days.

Best,
Channel Operations Team
channel@example-channel.com

parameters.subject: =❌ POA Not Approved — {{ $json.partnerName }} ({{ $json.quarter }})
parameters.text:
=Dear {{ $json.partnerName }} team,

After review, your Plan of Action for {{ $json.quarter }} has **not been approved** at this time.

---
POA ID: {{ $json.poaId }}
Quarter: {{ $json.quarter }}

**Reason:**
{{ $json.reviewComments || 'Please contact your channel manager for more information.' }}
---

**Next Steps:**
Please schedule a call with your channel manager to discuss an updated plan. You may submit a new POA at any time with revised targets and initiatives.

Best,
Channel Operations Team
channel@example-channel.com

└────────────────────────────────────────┘

parameters.subject: =✅ POA Achievement — {{ $json.partnerName }} ({{ $json.quarter }})
parameters.text:
=Dear {{ $json.partnerName }} team,

Congratulations! Your Plan of Action for {{ $json.quarter }} has achieved a score of **{{ $json.poaScore }}/100**, meeting the performance threshold.

---
Quarterly POA Scorecard
---
POA ID: {{ $json.poaId }}
Quarter: {{ $json.quarter }}

Revenue Attainment: {{ $json.revenueAttainmentPct }}% (${{ Number($json.revenueAttained).toLocaleString() }} of ${{ Number($json.revenueTarget).toLocaleString() }})
Deals Attainment: {{ $json.dealsAttainmentPct }}% ({{ $json.newDealsClosed }} of {{ $json.dealsTarget }})
MDF Utilization: {{ $json.mdfUtilizationPct }}%
Training Completed: {{ $json.trainingsCompleted }}

**Overall POA Score: {{ $json.poaScore }}/100 — {{ $json.poaScore >= 70 ? 'PASSED ✅' : ($json.poaScore >= 40 ? 'IN PROGRESS ⚠️' : 'AT RISK 🚨') }}**
---

This performance contributes to your tier standing. Continue the great work!

For next quarter's POA, submit a new plan before the quarter end.

Best,
Channel Operations Team
channel@example-channel.com

parameters.subject: =⚠️ POA Progress Update — {{ $json.partnerName }} ({{ $json.quarter }})
parameters.text:
=Dear {{ $json.partnerName }} team,

This is a progress update on your Plan of Action for {{ $json.quarter }}.

Your current POA score is **{{ $json.poaScore }}/100**, which is below the 70-point threshold.

---
Quarterly POA Scorecard
---
Revenue Attainment: {{ $json.revenueAttainmentPct }}% (${{ Number($json.revenueAttained).toLocaleString() }} of ${{ Number($json.revenueTarget).toLocaleString() }})
Deals Attainment: {{ $json.dealsAttainmentPct }}% ({{ $json.newDealsClosed }} of {{ $json.dealsTarget }})
MDF Utilization: {{ $json.mdfUtilizationPct }}%
Training Completed: {{ $json.trainingsCompleted }}

**Overall POA Score: {{ $json.poaScore }}/100**
---

**Recommended Actions:**
1. Schedule a check-in with your channel manager
2. Review targets vs. actuals and adjust strategy
3. Consider additional deal registrations or MDF-backed campaigns
4. Complete outstanding training

Your channel manager will be in touch to discuss a performance improvement plan if scores do not improve.

Best,
Channel Operations Team
channel@example-channel.com

parameters.subject: =🚨 Performance Improvement Plan — {{ $json.partnerName }} ({{ $json.quarter }})
parameters.text:
=Dear {{ $json.partnerName }} team,

We are writing to inform you that your Plan of Action for {{ $json.quarter }} has scored **{{ $json.poaScore }}/100**, which falls below the minimum threshold.

---
POA ID: {{ $json.poaId }}
Quarter: {{ $json.quarter }}
Score: {{ $json.poaScore }}/100

Revenue Attainment: {{ $json.revenueAttainmentPct }}%
Deals Attainment: {{ $json.dealsAttainmentPct }}%
MDF Utilization: {{ $json.mdfUtilizationPct }}%
Training Completed: {{ $json.trainingsCompleted }}
---

**Performance Improvement Plan**

As part of the {{ $json.partnerTier }} tier program requirements, the following actions are needed:

1. Schedule a mandatory QBR with your channel manager within 14 days
2. Submit a revised POA for the next quarter with realistic, achievable targets
3. Complete outstanding training and certification requirements
4. Review MDF opportunities for co-marketing initiatives

Failure to show measurable improvement within 60 days may affect your {{ $json.partnerTier }} tier standing.

Your channel manager will contact you to schedule the QBR.

Sincerely,
Channel Operations Team
channel@example-channel.com

parameters.subject: =🚨 ESCALATION: POA Failed — {{ $json.partnerName }} ({{ $json.quarter }})
parameters.text:
=Hi Channel Director,

This is an automatic escalation notice.

{{ $json.partnerName }} ({{ $json.partnerTier }} tier) has received a POA score of **{{ $json.poaScore }}/100** for {{ $json.quarter }}, which is below the minimum threshold.

---
Partner: {{ $json.partnerName }}
Tier: {{ $json.partnerTier }}
CM: {{ $json.channelManager || 'Unassigned' }}
POA ID: {{ $json.poaId }}
POA Score: {{ $json.poaScore }}/100

Revenue: ${{ Number($json.revenueAttained).toLocaleString() }} of ${{ Number($json.revenueTarget).toLocaleString() }} target
Deals: {{ $json.newDealsClosed }} of {{ $json.dealsTarget }} target
Training: {{ $json.trainingsCompleted }} completed
---

A Performance Improvement Plan has been sent to the partner.
Please follow up with the channel manager to ensure proper remediation.

This escalation was automatically triggered at {{ $json.submittedAt }}.

Channel Operations
channel@example-channel.com

parameters.subject: =⏰ Reminder: POA for {{ $json.quarter }} is Overdue — {{ $json.partnerName }}
parameters.text:
=Dear {{ $json.partnerName }} team,

This is a reminder that your Plan of Action for {{ $json.quarter }} is currently overdue.

---
POA ID: {{ $json.poaId || 'Not yet created' }}
Quarter: {{ $json.quarter }}
Overdue: {{ $json.body.overdueDays || $json.overdueDays || 'Unknown' }} days
---

Please submit your POA as soon as possible. All {{ $json.partnerTier }} tier partners are required to have an active Plan of Action on file.

{{ $json.overdueLevel === 'critical' ? 'This is a final reminder. Continued non-compliance may impact your tier standing.' : ($json.overdueLevel === 'warning' ? 'Please submit within the next 7 business days to avoid escalation.' : '') }}

To submit, POST to the partner-poa webhook with action="submit" and your plan details.

Best,
Channel Operations Team
channel@example-channel.com
